task: Make the new CityManager movement telemetry syntax compatible with the repository's C# 7.3 compiler.
resume_instruction: Kavey's Release build compiled five projects and failed only CityManager with CS8967 at lines 1248, 1258, 1342, and 1350. The cause is four multiline FormatMovementRecord calls placed directly inside interpolated-string expressions, which C# 7.3 rejects. Compute command/echo strings in locals before the interpolation in BuildBuddyPositionWindow and BuildBuddyPositionTelemetry, preserving exact output. Do not build or run AO. Finish with COMMIT or ABORT and return the cursor idle.
